name: Short / Reel / TikTok
description: Vertical 9:16, 15-60 s, instant hook, word-by-word subtitles.
structure: hook from the 1st second → the moment → punchline
rules:
# Vertical short
- A single idea or a single moment, 15 to 60 s. Hook within the first second.
- Reframe on the action (the shot's horizontal reframing), keep the face or the subject in frame.
- Big subtitles, 1 to 2 words at a time, bottom center.
- Very tight cuts, frequent zooms, a sound effect on every punchline.
- End on the punchline, no outro.
